BSA promotes Toni Ibrahim to Deputy Chief Executive Officer

Hiba Faisal
posted on Oct. 13, 2026 at 11:02 amOct 13, 2026

With nearly two decades of industry experience, Toni brings extensive market knowledge, commercial expertise, and a strong understanding of the outdoor advertising landscape in the UAE.

Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedIn

Blueshield Advertising Media LLC (BSA) has promoted Toni Ibrahim from Chief Sales Officer (CSO) to Deputy Chief Executive Officer (Deputy CEO), recognizing his 17 years of experience in the outdoor advertising industry.

With nearly two decades of industry experience, Toni brings extensive market knowledge, commercial expertise, and a strong understanding of the outdoor advertising landscape in the UAE.

In his new role as Deputy CEO, he will support the company’s strategic direction, business development, and continued growth, working closely with Founder and CEO Mr. Wissam Traboulsi to advance Blueshield Advertising Media’s objectives and strengthen its position in the outdoor advertising market.

His promotion marks an important milestone in his professional journey and reflects BSA’s confidence in his leadership as the company continues to pursue new opportunities and build on its established presence in the industry.

Mr, Wissam Traboulsi, CEO, said, “Toni Ibrahim brings 17 years of valuable experience in the outdoor advertising industry, along with extensive industry knowledge and a strong understanding of the market. His appointment as Deputy CEO reflects his experience and contribution to the business. I am confident that his leadership will play an important role in driving our continued growth, strengthening our market presence, and advancing our strategic objectives across the region.”
